authority: Velocity owns all editorial and programmatic routes. Canonical sites are outbound provider destinations only.
count_policy: Historical counts document the June 19 implementation; minimums are release floors. Growth above a floor is allowed and expected.

notes.approved_route_retirements: Raised from 1 to 184 on 2026-08-27. The 183 added are routes that scripts/community/map_signals_to_targets.js published under /personal-injury/ because its four-regex classifier returned 'pi' whenever all four missed - the default branch was the error bucket, not a vertical. Scraped forum posts about steroid cycles, HGH dosing, hair transplants, H-1B petitions, root canals and child custody were served with the personal-injury vertical's legal citations and its accident-lead CTA. Owner-approved retirement to the correct vertical hub; the classifier itself was fixed in 931be16ab. The pages remain on disk - retirement is reversible, deletion is not. effective_inventory (admitted + retired) is unchanged by this, which is the invariant that matters: routes are accounted for, not lost.
notes.route_retirements_2026_08_29: approved_route_retirements raised from 184 to 199 on 2026-08-29. The 15 rendered-but-unadmitted routes that data/content/rendered_route_exclusions.json had been carrying as an undispositioned backlog were all dispositioned, and all 15 retired: seven named the generating model in the slug (-openai-gpt-4o, -perplexity, -gemini-1-5-flash), four were template-only pages whose body described what the page should say instead of saying it, three were thin duplicate USCIS hub stubs sharing one body, and one was an exact duplicate insight titled '(2)'. Each carries its own reason in data/release/route_retirements.json. effective_inventory (admitted + retired) is unchanged, which is the invariant that matters: the routes are accounted for, not lost.
notes.route_retirements_2026_08_30: approved_route_retirements raised to 297 on 2026-08-30. 98 live community-question routes were retired because their subject had no relationship to the vertical whose path they occupied. Reason tally: {"NO_NETWORK_TOPIC":44,"SCRAPE_ARTIFACT_IN_TITLE":18,"MISFILED_VERTICAL":19,"NO_ANSWERABLE_SUBJECT":23}. The upstream cause is scripts/community/normalize_signals.js: it assigned a vertical from the SOURCE KEY, and the sources reddit_pi_legaladvice, reddit_pi_insurance and reddit_pi_ask_lawyers are r/legaladvice, r/Insurance and r/Ask_Lawyers - general-interest forums. Every post scraped from them became a personal-injury page regardless of subject, which is why 85 of these sat under /personal-injury/. That classifier now requires subject affinity, and scripts/validators/validate_vertical_topic_admission.js blocks the next one. effective_inventory (admitted + retired) is unchanged: the routes are accounted for, not lost.
